protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: The generated release page marks harness_version and harness_version_source as mixed within the comparison group. W1 admits the factual release observations but does not resolve or normalize the historical mixture.

The release README states current-tree task verification can report drift because task definitions were hardened after the archived run; recorded task fingerprints reproduce from Git history. W1 pins the sealed release bundle and source archive rather than treating current task files as the executed revision.
